renderer: Chromium ANGLE SwiftShader software WebGL only
scope: Actual production bundle; no app test hooks, app source changes, frame forcing, readPixels, GL state changes, or device-performance pass threshold. For contracts requiring creation evidence, actual attributes and default-buffer samples are queried once immediately after native context creation in untimed setup.
limitations: SwiftShader timings cannot establish physical-device FPS or lag improvement.
Bounded composited screenshots can miss subframe or between-sample flicker; buffer-write/context observations run throughout.
Screenshots add readback overhead. Phase timing is descriptive; draw/triangle and backing-pixel changes are reported separately.
